en-US.description: Advanced tool to create, format and edit disk partitions
en-US.longDescription:
Active@ Partition Manager helps you manage storage devices and the logical
drives or partitions that they contain.

You may create, delete, format and name partitions on your computer without
shutting down the system. Most configuration changes take effect immediately.

Supports the most popular file systems such as FAT, NTFS, exFAT, ReFS, HFS+,
Ext2/Ext3/ Ext4, BtrFS, UFS, XFS, JFS.
en-US.name: Active@ Partition Manager
